setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A carpenter wants to fell an ancient tree, while a young villager says it should have the right to live.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Birds continue nesting there, but builders must seek other timber.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The tree later falls in a storm, prompting questions about protection and nature.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The wood builds homes, and the village plants saplings in remembrance.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council agrees to protect nesting trees and review each harvest.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The debate remains unsettled, but villagers begin recording tree ages.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: A woodworker discovers the tree sheltered a rare creature and regrets the loss.

b2__text.name: Outcome B2
